Billing: Thanks for reaching out about your billing question. You can view your full billing history and update your payment method in your account settings. If something still looks off after checking there, our billing team will review your account and follow up shortly.
Shipping & Delivery: Thanks for checking in on your order. You can track its live status using the tracking link sent to your email. If the tracking hasn't updated in a while or something looks wrong, our team will look into it with the carrier and follow up.
Product Issue: We're sorry to hear about this — that's not the experience we want you to have. Our team will review the details of your issue and follow up with next steps, which may include a replacement or repair depending on what you're seeing.
Refund & Returns: Thanks for starting this request. You can find return/exchange instructions and a prepaid label (if eligible) in your order details. Refunds typically process within 5-7 business days once the return is received. Our team will follow up if anything needs manual review.
Sales Inquiry: Thanks for your interest! Someone from our sales team will follow up shortly with more details, pricing, and answers to your questions. In the meantime, feel free to share any specific requirements so we can tailor our response.
